question: How should the designated animal be protected within the yoginī circle?
premises: A mother protects her own son.
The son is born from a lover's seed.
This protection serves as the model.
inference: The animal should be protected just as a mother protects her own son born of a lover.
uncertainties: The application of the simile to the ritual subject is implied by context.
plain_english: Just as a mother protects her own son born from a lover, so one should protect him.
